ashes.description: Ashes left by a burnt-out fire.
ashes.acquisition: Take the Ashes that appear on the ground when a Firemaking fire burns out.
ashes.uses: Ashes have no recipe use in the current game.

boar_tusk.description: A Boar drop used in Hides of the Frontier.
boar_tusk.acquisition: Drops from Boar in Main Overworld.
boar_tusk.uses: Turn in 4 boar tusks with 2 wolf fangs to Tanner Rusk for Hides of the Frontier.

coins.description: Currency used to buy items from merchants.
coins.acquisition: Earn Coins by selling items, collecting enemy drops, or completing quests such as Hides of the Frontier.
coins.uses: Spend Coins at merchants. Check stock and trade access before planning a purchase.

feathers_bundle.description: A bundled feather resource used to finish headless arrow recipes in Fletching.
feathers_bundle.uses: Combined with shafts across each wood tier to produce headless arrows for later arrow assembly.

goblin_club.description: A trophy dropped by Goblin Grunts.
goblin_club.acquisition: Drops from Goblin Grunt in Main Overworld.
goblin_club.uses: This drop is not equippable and has no recipe use in the current game.

guard_crest.acquisition: Drops from Guard in Main Overworld.
guard_crest.uses: This drop is not equippable and has no recipe use in the current game.

guard_spear.acquisition: Drops from Guard in Main Overworld.
guard_spear.uses: This drop is not equippable and has no recipe use in the current game.

hammer.description: A core workshop tool used throughout smithing and metal assembly recipes.
hammer.acquisition: Sold by Borin Ironvein in Main Overworld.

knife.description: A cutting tool used across fletching and simple crafting workflows.
knife.acquisition: Stocked by general stores in Main Overworld, with the exported default stock listing ten at a time.
knife.uses: Used to shape logs and related materials in fletching workflows.

rat_tail.acquisition: Drops from Rat in Main Overworld.
rat_tail.uses: This drop is not equippable and has no recipe use in the current game.

soft_clay.description: Soft clay used to imprint jewelry moulds.
soft_clay.acquisition: Use Clay on water at Crafting level 1.
soft_clay.uses: Near a crafting bench, use Soft Clay on a Borrowed Ring, Borrowed Amulet, or Borrowed Tiara to make the matching imprinted mould. Fire the imprinted mould before using it for jewelry.

tinderbox.description: A basic firemaking tool used to ignite logs.
tinderbox.acquisition: Stocked by general stores in Main Overworld.
tinderbox.uses: Used to light logs for Firemaking.

wolf_fang.description: A Wolf drop used in Hides of the Frontier.
wolf_fang.acquisition: Drops from Wolf in Main Overworld.
wolf_fang.uses: Turn in 2 wolf fangs with 4 boar tusks to Tanner Rusk for Hides of the Frontier.
